description: A function `(set, get, api) => partialState` for one feature; slices are spread into a single store initializer.
Middleware that saves state to a storage (default `localStorage`) and rehydrates it on creation.
`persist` option selecting which fields are saved.
The stored value is `{ state, version }`; `migrate(persisted, oldVersion)` upgrades older shapes on hydration.
Middleware connecting the store to the Redux DevTools extension; the third argument of `set` names the action.
`createStore` from `zustand` or `zustand/vanilla` returns a store API without a hook; read it in React with `useStore(store, selector)`.
